links.outcome: Referral safety (binary) of LLM responses to oral cancer patient scenarios
links.effect: Referral-safe responses in 90.0% of Gemini and 92.1% of Grok outputs (p = 0.536), so roughly 8-10% of responses were not referral-safe.
links.quote: Referral-safe responses were observed in 90.0% of Gemini and 92.1% of Grok outputs (p = 0.536).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, readability, temporal stability, and referral safety of Gemini and Grok across standardized oral cancer patient scenarios without testing an organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
